description: Oracle Watch for monitored trust signals. Use it to read one trust snapshot or history series, buy a 24h monitored window, or poll/close an already purchased window. Each call selects the branch with "op": snapshot, history, begin, poll or close. Do not use it for pre-trade safety (use trade_guard op check_safety), do not buy a second window for the same subject, and never reuse a token after close. Returns the trust signal or history series, the windowId plus one-time oww_ token and expiry for begin, and the poll signal or combined close summary for window ops. Absorbs the deprecated names oracle_watch, oracle_watch_window_begin and oracle_watch_window_control.

window_token.description: One-time oww_ token from the purchase

name: oracle_watch_window
